briefing: Markets slipped slightly (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%), which is a neutral day rather than a risk-off one. Today, Nov 26, is Thanksgiving and US exchanges are closed, so these figures likely reflect Wednesday's close. The portfolio is up 49.9% overall, and all 7 holdings stay in place for their automatic profit targets and stop-losses to manage. Cash is above the $500 threshold, so I'm putting it into one medium-conviction position in RH, the candidate with full signal confirmation and RSI furthest from overbought. CDW was passed over because its RSI of 68.2 is close to overbought.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Around major holidays like Thanksgiving, many traders and institutions take time off, so fewer shares change hands and US markets close entirely on the day itself. With fewer buyers and sellers, small orders can move prices more than usual, and index moves on these days often say less about the market's real direction. That's why a mild dip right before a holiday is usually treated as noise rather than a warning sign.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 每逢感恩節等重要假期，不少交易員及機構投資者都會休假，市場成交因而明顯萎縮，美股更會在假期當日全日休市。由於買賣雙方減少，即使是小額買賣盤亦可能令股價出現較大波動，因此假期前後的指數表現往往未能真實反映大市方向。正因如此，假期前的輕微回調一般被視為市場雜音，而非警號。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted modestly lower, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, a move small enough to count as neutral. No news headlines came with today's data, so the decline can't be tied to a specific catalyst, but light, low-conviction trading is typical going into the Thanksgiving holiday as many participants step away. Under the surface, several mid-cap names such as RH, CDW and INIO still showed strong momentum with above-average volume, which suggests stock-specific buying even though the indexes were soft.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股窄幅偏軟，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數則微跌0.3%，整體走勢屬中性。今日未有相關新聞資料，故難以將跌勢歸因於特定消息；不過臨近感恩節假期，不少投資者提早離場，市況淡靜、成交缺乏方向屬常見現象。值得留意的是，雖然大市偏弱，RH、CDW及INIO等中型股仍錄得強勁動能並伴隨成交放量，反映個股層面仍有資金承接。

trades.reasoning: RH shows all four confirmation signals (MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with RSI at 57.6, so it has room to run before it gets overbought, and it is the cleanest setup available for the $645 of idle cash and 3 open slots.
